# jsvoice

> Browser voice-command library. Default STT: on-device Whisper tiny (any modern browser). Optional Native Web Speech and React Hyper UI Kit.

## Lead (read first)

- /docs/AI_IMPLEMENTATION.md — primary AI implementation guide
- /AGENTS.md — non-negotiable rules
- /src/index.js — package entry (header comments = same rules)
- /README.md — human quick start + Start here table

## Critical

- Package: `jsvoice`
- Default: `createVoice()` → engineMode `local` → `Xenova/whisper-tiny.en`
- Peer: `@xenova/transformers` required for default path
- Do not gate on `JSVoice.isApiSupported` (Native only)
- User gesture required for `start()` / `toggle()`

## Optional deeper docs

- /docs/HYPER_VOICE_UI_KIT.md

## Install

```bash
npm install jsvoice @xenova/transformers
```
